local or unauthenticated remote attackers executing programs with root privileges
Discoverer: RiskIQ Leading Threat Researcher Yonathan Klijnsma
Impacted Systems: Exim mail transfer agent (MTA) software versions 4.80 up to 4.92.3
Attack Vector: exploitation of heap-based buffer overflow via long EHLO string
remote exploitation of MX servers running vulnerable Exim versions
local or remote attackers exploiting unusual configurations
